findings.title: Evidence downgrade does not propagate to driver narrative and scope-specific projections

unsupported_evidence_node.conclusion: Latest H1 gives actual workload/conversion direction. Counts and capacity stock cannot establish a future price or a three-year range.

evidence.actual_source_support: Other only the H1 historical decline row; discontinued only zero/prior revenue and perimeter context. Neither supplies a forward workload/project/ramp mechanism.
evidence.secondary_projection: All12 calibrations repeat H2TIDES comparable from72.6/44.3% and Bachem limitations; these are not own-business bases for the6 Testing/Biology entries.

findings.impact: Native reports publish a positive operating assertion that the repaired evidence does not support; the honest U07/no-future-mechanism limitation elsewhere does not retract that assertion. Figures remain arithmetically unchanged.
findings.root_cause: Repair updates primary claim role/quote but leaves copied driver and parallel calibration text as independent stale projections.
findings.minimal_fix: At the authoring owner regenerate thesis/evidence-node explanation/causal-chain/falsifiers and relevant limitation text from the current evidence disposition and actual scope. For history-only drivers describe explicitly conditional runoff/zero, not disclosed ramp. Keep legitimate known mechanisms, negative/zero contributions and all revenue math. No company-keyword classifier or global validator relaxation.
findings.acceptance: A neutral history-only/zero-perimeter fixture preserves amounts but no longer exports a disclosed operating-mechanism assertion; a genuinely sourced mechanism remains positive. Both main and stress rendered outputs must reflect the same corrected disposition.

findings.title: Base-only D&M implied growth is falsely asserted for Low and High

evidence.copied_assertion: this index requires H2 D&M growth of about +35.3%
evidence.condition: Hold H2 residual at comparable H2 FY2025 =2585.45306019 CNYm; prior H2 D&M=11240.20845397 CNYm.

findings.impact: The explanation understates High and overstates Low implied operating requirements in the largest driver; the native amounts are correct.
findings.root_cause: A Base cross-check was copied across scope/scenario-specific target parameters without retaining its Base label.
findings.minimal_fix: Generate scenario-specific explanations from the existing common component bridge, or explicitly label35.3% as a Base-only comparison rather than this index. Use the scenario whole recognized H2 amount, including its price/FX, not activity alone. Do not tune forecast numbers to match the mistaken text.
findings.acceptance: Low/Base/High explanations either disclose their own4.3/35.3/65.2% conditional requirement or name only the Base comparison; a different neutral multi-scenario fixture cannot inherit the first scenario number.

findings.title: Rounding amplification is overstated and points to an absent rounding table

evidence.claimed: several percentage points of uncertainty; the sensitivity table shows how the implied number moves with the rounding basis
evidence.actual_tables: Only native sensitivities and ±10% residual-condition tables, not a displayed-input rounding table.
evidence.independent_rounding_only_probe: Assuming conventional nearest rounding for H1 TIDES72.6±0.05亿元 and D&M149.9±0.05亿元 and their44.3/72.7% rates±0.05 percentage point,16 corner combinations give about5.31867–5.91918% residual H1 growth (width0.6005 percentage point), not several points. This is not empirical uncertainty or a confidence interval.

findings.root_cause: A qualitative caution was given quantitative magnitude without calculating it; a conditional scenario sensitivity was confused with display-rounding propagation.
findings.minimal_fix: Remove the unsupported several-points claim and absent-table reference, or provide the small explicitly rounding-only calculation with its assumptions. Keep approximately5.6% and current forecast values.
findings.acceptance: Documentation names actual existing tables; any rounding interval is separated from empirical uncertainty and residual scenario sensitivity.

evidence.confidence_sentence: §6 calls an unchanged24.017059... confidence score one piece of proof that numbers were not secretly changed. That structural score is not a test of forecast-value equality.

findings.impact: Full-document readers have the proper subtotal qualification elsewhere, so this is a precision/provenance issue rather than a discovered amount defect.
findings.root_cause: Manual narrative updates and completion statements are not checked against the exact field/sentence changed.
findings.minimal_fix: Qualify the remaining sentence as scenario segment_subtotal and cite actual numerical-diff reconciliation. Do not use constant confidence as a numerical-integrity check. Correct the tail closure statement to the actual final text. No new full-chain/model rerun needed for memo-only edits.
